content.ascii:
Diagram
|-- Diagram: readonly diagramId, revisionId, id, revision, content, sourceContext, jumps?
|-- diagramId is the stable service identity; id is the local canvas content key.
|-- content: DeepReadonly<DiagramContent>; sourceContext: DeepReadonly<DiagramSourceContext>
|-- The repository-independent value is shared by canvas, persistence and agents.
|-- DiagramInput: id, revision, ascii, structureKind?, mappings?, evidence?, source?, jumps?
|-- Runtime editing responsibility sits at service and controller boundaries.
|-- buildDiagramContent(ascii, revisionId, kind, parserVersion): DiagramContent
|-- Construction accepts printable ASCII with LF and a maximum of 20000 characters.
|-- DiagramContent: revisionId, ascii, asciiSha256, structure
|-- Content stores either plain diagram structure or a parsed tree.
|-- structure.kind: 'diagram' | 'tree'; parserVersion: 'ascii-tree-1' | 'ascii-tree-2'
|-- Tree parsing supplies roots, parent links, children and folding ranges.
|-- DiagramContentNode: id, label, line, branchColumn, startColumn, endColumn
|-- Node identities depend on content revision, ASCII hash and source line.
|-- visibleContentLines(content, collapsedIds): number[]
|-- Visibility requires tree fold ranges and rejects unknown collapsed node IDs.
|-- DiagramSourceContext: binding?, contentHash, mappings, evidence
|-- Source context ties local ASCII mappings to captured evidence ranges.
|-- DiagramSourceBinding: sourceId, repositoryIdentity, corpus, domainProfileId
|-- Binding validation pairs source-code with git-worktree and requires an absolute root.
|-- validateDiagram(diagram) -> buildDiagramContent(...), validateDiagramJumps(...), validateDiagramLocalMappings(...)
|-- Validation checks canonical content, matching hashes and service identity prefixes.
|-- mapping.entityId + mapping.sourceRangeIndex -> evidence entity + range [schematic]
|-- Every mapping must resolve to evidence; range IDs and source IDs must agree when present.
|-- diagramSource(diagram) -> queryDiagramSourceContext(diagram.sourceContext)
|-- Source queries centralize mapping/evidence joins and return derived read-only results.
|-- queryDiagramSourceContext(context) -> { context, mappings, forSelection, entries, search }
|-- Selection queries require a rectangle; search uses entity IDs, labels, paths and symbols.
|-- regionSelectionItem(diagram, boxId, rect): SelectionItem
`-- Region capture retains ASCII, content revision and selected node IDs for later use.
